name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have append2 {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a ⊆ c ++ [h1]) (hb : b ⊆ d ++ [h1]) :
      a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d ++ [h1] := by grind
  have append3 {a b c d e f : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a ⊆ d ++ [h1]) (hb : b ⊆ e ++ [h1])
      (hc : c ⊆ f ++ [h1]) :
      a ++ b ++ c ⊆ d ++ e ++ f ++ [h1] := by grind
  induction post <;> simp [substOld]
  case fvar => intros x Hin; simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_true,
    List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, true_or]
  case op => intros x Hin; simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_true,
    List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, true_or]
  case const => intros x Hin; simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_true,
    List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, true_or]
  case bvar => intros x Hin; simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_true,
    List.mem_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, true_or]
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    exact append3 cih tih eih
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split
      · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all only [List.append_assoc, List.append_subset, List.subset_append_of_subset_right, and_true,
    List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, or_true]
      · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        exact ih2 Hin
    · simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, imp_false, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      exact append2 ih1 ih2
  case quant trih eih =>
    simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    exact append2 trih eih
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    exact append2 ih1 ih2
